- Wealth Management: The company is placing significant focus on the wealth category, specifically equity brokerage and mutual fund distribution, as a key area for growth.

- Artificial Intelligence: The speaker is prioritizing the integration and monetization of AI. Efforts are underway to develop revenue streams through AI, with some products already generating early results. In this video, we explain everything you need to know about the National Common Mobility Card (NCMC), how it works, where it can be used, and how you can conveniently recharge your NCMC card online using the Paytm app.

NCMC was introduced to make daily travel easier by allowing commuters to use a single card across multiple transit services. Whether you travel by metro, bus, or use parking and toll facilities, NCMC helps simplify your journey with seamless digital payments.

📌 In this video, you'll learn:
✅ What is an NCMC Card?
✅ Full form of NCMC (National Common Mobility Card)
✅ Benefits of using an NCMC-enabled card
✅ Where can you use an NCMC Card?
✅ Metro, bus, parking, toll and retail payment use cases
✅ How to recharge NCMC Card online on Paytm
✅ Step-by-step NCMC recharge process
✅ Why online recharge is more convenient for daily commuters

How to Recharge NCMC Card on Paytm
- Open the Paytm app
- Search for "NCMC Recharge" or visit the Transit & Metro section
- Select your metro or supported service
- Enter your NCMC card details
- Choose the recharge amount
- Complete payment using UPI, bank account, debit card, or credit card

Your NCMC recharge can be completed in just a few taps.

💡 Why Use NCMC?
• One card for multiple transit services
• Faster travel experience
• Reduced dependency on cash
• Convenient digital payments
• Easy online recharge through Paytm
• Saves time by avoiding recharge queues

If you're a daily commuter who uses metro services, city buses, parking facilities, or other public transport systems, NCMC can make your travel experience smoother and more convenient.

Download Paytm and recharge your NCMC Card anytime, anywhere.

snippet.title: Paytm Q4 FY2026 Earnings Call | First Full Year of Profit | By Paytm | #PaytmKaro
snippet.description:
Paytm reports its Q4 FY2026 and full year FY2026 earnings results — marking a landmark year of disciplined compounding and its first full year of profitability.
In this earnings call, Paytm's leadership discusses the company's financial performance, business momentum across payments, financial services, and consumer franchise, and its outlook for FY2027.
📊 Key Highlights — Q4 FY2026

Revenue: ₹2,264 Cr | +26% YoY (comparable basis)
Contribution Profit: ₹1,254 Cr | +31% YoY
EBITDA: ₹132 Cr | +₹330 Cr YoY improvement
Merchant GMV: ₹6.5 Lakh Cr | +27% YoY
Consumer UPI GTV: ₹5.5 Lakh Cr | +46% YoY — growing at 2.2x industry
MTUs: 7.7 Crore | +50 Lakh YoY
Financial Services Revenue: ₹750 Cr | +38% YoY

📊 Key Highlights — Full Year FY2026

Revenue: ₹8,437 Cr | +22% YoY
EBITDA: ₹502 Cr (vs -₹1,506 Cr in FY25) — a ₹2,008 Cr swing
PAT: ₹552 Cr (vs -₹663 Cr in FY25)
Cash Balance: ₹13,315 Cr

🔍 Topics Covered

Merchant payments growth and payment processing margin expansion
Financial services distribution business — merchant loans, repeat borrowers
Consumer UPI market share gains — growing at 2.2x industry growth rate
AI across the organisation — from Soundbox to fraud detection to consumer acquisition
Marketing Services — the next growth frontier powered by AI agents
FY2027 outlook — four compounding engines driving accelerated growth and margin expansion
Capital allocation strategy and cash deployment
